title: The Spire of Highmoor
author: Emrys Villalobos
blurb: Mara Vasquez, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
